findings.claim: The current partial sensor (SHA 6f34cb98…, correctly declared incomplete by the delta) asserts in isolatedCopy(true) that the production ddl directory equals exactly the 49-file inventory; once TASK-0029 supplies the three real ddl/19 files, the static probe fails on this inventory precondition rather than on the apply contract, so the sensor as-is cannot satisfy the delta's own requirement that the same frozen harness work both pre-SQL (49) and post-SQL (49+3) without post-freeze edits. The delta anticipates this ('harness pré/pós-SQL' in C4-OD-V3-INDEX.md item 1), but no document pins this exact assertion as the code-level gap.
findings.fix: During the authorized same-iteration completion, before computing the freeze SHA, rework the static-probe precondition so it accepts both inventory states (write synthetic ddl/19 probes only when the real files are absent, and use the real ones read-only when present), keeping synthetic SQL confined to the isolated static copy; then reproduce the contractual static RED and freeze the completed sensor hash.

notes: Scope: single OWNER-authorized documentary sequence-delta review of the frozen candidate in ctg-0001-c4-od-v3-review-sequence-delta-1.manifest.json (candidate d09cfd59…). Read-only; no commands, tests, generation, SQL or DB connections were executed; hash verification belongs to the adapter and was not independently recomputed; no runtime PASS observed or claimed.

The static RED premise is structurally genuine: apply.sh (lines 15, 38-41) opens one psql per file with no --single-transaction or advisory lock, so the spec's static contract test (lines 225-227) fails contractually; the file holds exactly 1 static test plus 8 DB tests gated by explicit authorization/URL as BLOCKED-not-RED (lines 304-308, 321-325), zero DB connections in the static path, synthetic SQL confined to the isolated copy, and production SQL never edited (inject writes only to the temp copy).
